ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of low-intensity (black) pixels to high-intensity (white) pixels, with the dark pixels dominating the interior regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black masses located centrally in both lobes; high-contrast white mottling and blobs are clustered along the trailing edge boundaries and the lower central junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 35-40 degrees relative to the vertical axis of the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the medial and distal trailing edges; pixel-amplitude variations range from shallow 5-pixel peaks to deeper 15-pixel valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced convex curvature along the trailing edge leading to sharp, upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct circular high-contrast clusters localized on the extreme distal tips of both lobes, suggesting heavy barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple non-parallel linear streaks (rake marks) visible as high-intensity disruptions across the dark pigmented surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentation on the right lobe's trailing edge; extensive linear scarring across the central fluke area.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy biological encrustation on the tips resulting in a highly textured, irregular 2D silhouette that breaks the smooth geometric line of the fluke boundary.
